limitation: v1 contribution is stated per active user. It is not per acquired user.

description: A person who installed or signed up through the paid or unpaid channel being costed. Activation into an active user is a separate blank rate.
limitation: CAC divides by this person. Contribution does not, until activation is observed.

description: A delegated checkout attempt. Equals orders x coverage x delegated share. It is not an attributable order.
limitation: Coverage is applied once, here. It is not applied again as a second penalty on attributable orders.

description: An attempt that completes and also meets the program's qualifying-click and payment rules. Historical tracked orders are not in this count.
limitation: Attributable share is an assumption. Program eligibility can set the booked count to zero even when this formula is positive.

description: Amazon affiliate revenue booked for the startup placing orders on the user's behalf.
formula_or_dependency: eligibility gate, not the commission formula
sensitivity: v1 arithmetic is retained in the reproduction rows and is not booked
limitation: The co.jp policies URL returned English Program Policies updated 2026-04-14. Participation Requirements 6(k) prohibits orders on behalf of another person. The Japanese operating agreement was not opened.
permission_status: adverse clause in retrieved English text (6(k), on-behalf orders)

description: Affiliate revenue from a disclosed qualifying referral followed by the user's merchant-hosted purchase.
formula_or_dependency: unknown until the program, surface, and approval are checked
limitation: Blank means unknown. It does not mean zero and it does not mean the v1 upside.
permission_status: unresolved by program and surface; Rakuten restricts closed/one-to-one tools except approved corporate partners (search extract)
underwriting_treatment: exclude until program x surface approval is confirmed

description: Affiliate revenue from reading receipts or maintaining a timeline, with no new qualifying click.
